correctness.rationale: The signed Lamperti transform defines the nonsticking branch and turns the motion into constant speeds ±v. The law regenerates at a complete reset; solving the two-state Fourier resolvent gives stationary characteristic function r(r+2ν)/(r(r+2ν)+v²k²), hence the Laplace scale used in the variance. Reflection symmetry gives mean zero and eliminates all paths with a reset from the stationary covariance, so C(t)=exp(−rt)H(t) for the no-reset correlation H. Stationarity of g² gives H'(0+)=rC(0)/2. For the second derivative, differentiate H'(t)=v E[g(Y_0)Σ_t g'(Y_t)] in the unreset dynamics. Zero flips give the drift term v² E[g g'']; the probabilities of zero and one flip give −2ν H'(0+) and two or more flips contribute o(t) to H'(t). For 1<p<2 the unreset drift difference quotient after multiplication by g(Y_0) is controlled by a constant times |Y_0|^(2p−2) on |Y_0|>2vt; on the shrinking inner region it is O(t^(2p−2)). This justifies the singular-origin boundary limit with the Laplace tails. More generally the integral of g'' against the shifted initial density weighted by g is continuous near zero lag, by local integrability of g'' and the bounded weighted density with exponential tails. Product differentiation cancels the two reset terms of second order, giving C''(0+)/C(0)=(p−1)r(r+2ν)/(2(2p−1))−rν=r(αr−4ν)/(2(α+2)). At α=0, g is linear and the drift term is zero. The two derivatives determine positive r and ν in sequence for known α, then the stationary variance determines a unique positive v. This is a population inverse, not estimation under noise. The supplied checker was inspected, not executed.

value.rationale: The physical-coordinate nonlinearity changes the sign of initial curvature while leaving the first normalized slope unchanged and negative. The explicit threshold separates these two effects and permits the tumbling rate and speed scale to be distinguished from the reset rate using only short-lag population data and the stationary variance. No inverse robustness or applicability outside the model is asserted.
